preregistration.emission: Fixed 37,654-dot budget; deterministic probability ranking; 2 px dot inhibition and 2 px collar derived only from fold-visible faults (full catalogue in production).
experiments: Experiment 1: ten-layer core control versus core plus raw K/Th/U.
Experiment 2: raw-radiometric arm versus full RMRB transform arm.
preregistration.external_data_obtainability: The official USGS GeoDAWN source is named at DOI 10.5066/P93LGLVQ. This sandbox cannot reach usgs.gov; a hash-pinned owner-derived mirror is obtainable from GitHub and is not mislabelled organizer-authenticated.
preregistration.holdout: Unmodified vendor gems57 buffered_component_draw and evaluate_holdout; seeds 20/21; whole 8-connected components; 3 px feature buffer; 12 px label-blind quadrant erosion; visible faults masked pixel-exactly; pooled DTI alpha 0.2 beta 0.8 triangular 300 m; paired 20 km block bootstrap.
preregistration.hypothesis: A narrow K residual from the broad K~Th+U mixing relation, when line-coherent and aligned with a persistent RTP magnetic edge, may identify an unmapped fault-related alteration/contact boundary.
preregistration.lane_resolution: The supplied prompt did not contain a separate method paragraph. To satisfy the autonomous/no-manual-input instruction, this run selects exactly one lane before experimentation and records the missing assignment as an irregularity.
preregistration.leakage_stop: Every model channel alone; symmetric AUC above 0.90 stops the run.
preregistration.learning: Fold-proper HGB positive/unlabelled learner: visible faults only, training quadrants exclude the tested quadrant; no catalogue-derived model feature.
preregistration.mechanism: Hydrothermal redistribution and fault juxtaposition can create a narrow radiometric mixing residual; an RTP edge supplies independent structural persistence.
preregistration.non_fault_mimic: Weathering or transported sediment at an unfaulted lithologic contact; survey gridding edges can also mimic a lineament.
preregistration.promotion_gate: Candidate must exceed the matched best control, paired 95% delta CI must be wholly positive, and candidate must exceed the best located shared-v2 context value. Any registry rho >0.90 or forward 3 px overlap >0.70 blocks promotion. Local format validation cannot override a scientific or registry failure.
source_layers: owner-mirrored USGS GeoDAWN radiometric K, Th and U uint8 grids
ten owner-mirrored competition core geophysics/topography control bands
preregistration.transform: Robust Huber K~Th+U residual, 20 px background removal, residual gradient persistence at 1.5/3 px, RTP gradient persistence at 2/4 px, absolute cross-gradient alignment and residual structure-tensor coherence.
